title: Introduction to Nigerian Legal System II

items.q: Vicarious liability may be defined as
o: the rule that a person must take care not to harm those he should foresee
liability of an employer for a wrong done by an employee at work
the organ of government that interprets the law and decides disputes between parties
the fair procedures the state must follow before depriving a person of rights
items.s: Vicarious liability: liability of an employer for a wrong done by an employee at work. The other options describe Due process, Neighbour principle, Judiciary.

items.q: Offer may be defined as
o: the French writer whose work set out the modern doctrine of separated powers
the right of a party to present his case before an impartial court

items.s: Offer: a definite promise made intending that it shall become binding on acceptance. The other options describe Fair hearing, Montesquieu, Alien.

items.q: Which of the following best describes Ministry of Justice?

items.s: Ministry of Justice: the department of government that handles legal advice and prosecutions. The other options describe Unfettered discretion, Separation of powers, Consideration.

items.q: Which term is described by “the doctrine that the law alone governs and no person stands above it”?

items.s: Supremacy of law is the doctrine that the law alone governs and no person stands above it.

items.q: The statement “the principle that all persons are subject to the same law and courts” describes which of the following?

items.s: Equality before the law is the principle that all persons are subject to the same law and courts.

items.s: Arbitrary power: power exercised according to personal whim rather than settled legal rules. The other options describe Donoghue v Stevenson, Right of occupancy, Unfettered discretion.
